meta.title: About us
meta.description: A small studio that ships and then sleeps.

properties.content: We're a small studio. We hand sites to clients and we like our phones quiet afterwards — which is why this starter runs on a CMS where an editor can't break the site: no broken links, no accidental publishes, no lost content.
